correctness.rationale: For d>=3 the full degree-1+2 harmonic band splits into five orthogonal reducing sectors of dimensions 1,d−1,1,d−1,(d−2)(d+1)/2. Probability-normalized uniform sphere moments yield precisely the five upper-tail integral densities. Increasing likelihood ratios prove A>D>B and D>E. Directly differentiated boundary identities give C−A, C−D, A−D, locating the only two crossings at 1/sqrt(d) and sqrt(d+2)/d and their direction. Spectral decomposition yields the globally optimal deficit coefficient including the top-eigenvalue tie. A separate checker ran 294 finite assertions across six dimensions; they corroborate rather than replace the analytic proof.
